title: A deliberate hold
description: A progress sweep makes the time needed for an important action visible.
useCase: Add a deliberate confirmation gesture to an occasional action, with clear cancellation.
interaction: Hold the button, or hold Space or Enter
reducedMotion: The timer still requires a deliberate hold; text reports progress and the fill changes only at completion.
limitations: Demonstrates a local archive state. Pausing cancels any hold and disables confirmation until resumed. Reduced motion preserves the full hold time. Offer another confirmation method if a sustained press is unsuitable for your users.
look: Warm off-white page with one white rounded button and a grey caption underneath.
motion: Holding the button sweeps a dark fill left to right at constant speed for 1.6 s; releasing early drains it back 2.5× faster; completion confirms.
adapt: Hold timing and cancellation live in `useHoldToConfirm` (the example passes `duration: 1600`); the fill is a `clipPath` inset driven by `animate` with linear easing. Replace the archive label and `onConfirm`; keep pointer-cancel and Escape handling.
